about_the_game:
After an accident, you're uploaded into a consciousness backup. The Voice guides you, trying to uncover who you truly are but the catch is… you have dissociative identity disorder. As your other personalities begin warning you not to trust The Voice, you realize every side is trying to convince you. Do your other personalities want to permanently take over your body or is The Voice the real threat?

Rules You Must Always Follow:

1. If you hear a voice other than The Voice, ignore it.

2. If you encounter a being you're certain is not human, do not look at it. It may try to get your attention or simply ignore you. No matter what, do not look.

3. If you detect any sign of life having moved or moving, turn back immediately and press the red button. We will eliminate the threat and transfer you to a new section.

4. As soon as you complete the task you were given, turn back and press the blue button. Do not linger.

Note: These rules are independent of the section rules and must always be followed by patient.

Features:

  • In this game, you will carry out the tasks given to you by The Voice, paying attention both to the section rules and to the rules that must always be followed.

  • There are no classic "Go there, get that." tasks in this game. Instead, you’ll be completing tasks with more interesting and entertaining concepts.

  • Photorealistic graphics.

  • No randomized events.

  • Obey the Voice is a short (~60 minute) psychological horror walking simulator that also includes jumpscares.

This teaser trailer and the provided screenshots reflect the early development stage of Obey the Voice. They are intended to give you a sense of the game's atmosphere and the tension you will experience.

The full release will feature extended gameplay footage, updated screenshots, and all core story content. Adding to your wishlist is the biggest support you can give us. Thank you!

content_descriptors.notes: Obey the Voice™ contains blood, depictions of murder, corpses, and physical and psychological violence.

name: Obey the Voice™

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Higher
  • Processor: INTEL CORE i3 8TH GEN or AMD RYZEN 3 2ND GEN
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RADEON RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Don’t worry about fiddling with graphics settings, this game keeps it simple. With the minimum system requirements, you can enjoy it at Full HD and 30 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Higher
  • Processor: INTEL CORE i5 9TH GEN or AMD RYZEN 5 3RD GEN
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 Super or AMD RADEON RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Don’t worry about fiddling with graphics settings, this game keeps it simple. With the recommended system requirements, you can enjoy it at Full HD and 60 FPS.

short_description: You are here to listen to The Voice, do what he says. But don't listen to other voices...
